facts.fact: 索伦两步并作一步下楼进书房，仍恼火阿门挑的时机总是这么糟。
facts.anchor: I take the stairs down to my study two at a time, still irritated. Armen’s timing is shit, as usual.

facts.fact: 阿门举着薄黑文件夹汇报：黑卡办妥、账户干净、没有可追查的纸面痕迹，并已存入索伦指定的确切金额。
facts.anchor: “Black card’s done. Properly set up, clean accounts, no paper trail that leads anywhere useful. Deposited the exact amount you told me to.

facts.fact: 卡上以银色凸印着‘克里斯托弗·辛克莱’——索伦把自己的姓给了基特。
facts.anchor: The name embossed on the card sits there in clean silver lettering. ‘Christopher Sinclair.’

facts.fact: 索伦说难道要把埃弗利印在卡上，语气对阿门的调侃毫不买账。
facts.anchor: I’m not putting Everly on the fucking card, am I?” I say completely unamused by his antics.

facts.fact: 索伦在书桌后的大画上按暗扣，画幅无声外旋，露出嵌在墙里的保险箱。
facts.anchor: It swings outward on silent hinges when I press the hidden catch; my safe sits recessed in the wall.

facts.fact: 索伦叮嘱阿门密码只在紧急时用，除非他死了或出了大问题。
facts.anchor: “The code is only for emergencies,” I tell him. “You don’t open this unless I’m dead

facts.fact: 索伦把不宜数字化的条目写进锁在书桌底抽屉里的厚重账簿。
facts.anchor: pen moving steadily across the page of one of the heavy logbooks I keep locked in the bottom drawer

facts.fact: 他感到一种无形的不安：某种遥远却已注定的事正在逼近。
facts.anchor: a quiet, persistent sense that something is shifting… something distant but already fated, drawing closer with every hour that passes.
